definitions.accumulated_wait: min(service start, 480-minute horizon) minus arrival, INCLUDING patients never started
definitions.calendar: Deterministic synthetic days beginning 2026-01-05 06:00 UTC (08:00 Africa/Harare)
definitions.demand: Poisson hourly counts with declared weekday-hour profiles and optional gradual trend; not fitted real-clinic arrival process
definitions.p90: Mean of completed-case replication-specific P90s, not pooled P90
definitions.scope: Supporting consultation-stage studies; original whole-outpatient-journey primary experiment remains unchanged
definitions.service: Independent bounded lognormal synthetic consultation duration: mean parameter 12 min, log SD .45, clipped 1–30 min
definitions.unserved: Arrived cases not completed by the finite 480-minute horizon
definitions.urgency: Synthetic clinician-confirmed P1–P5 inputs; never predicted or modified in these experiments
definitions.waiting: Consultation service start minus consultation queue arrival; excludes service

limitations: Synthetic software experiments, not fieldwork or clinical validation
Suggested arrangements require human review; no live staff or queue mutation
Prediction accuracy does not itself cause shorter waits
No patient-specific service duration is used to rank patients
A distinction grade, clinical benefit, distribution-free temporal coverage or statistical power is not guaranteed
results.research_label: SYNTHETIC OPERATIONAL RESEARCH — NOT CLINICAL EVIDENCE

forecast.model: Regularised Poisson count regression; weekday-hour interactions and calendar trend

limitations: Single consultation stage; does not replace primary whole-journey FCFS/urgency/hybrid experiment
Fixed rooms preserve category order within each compatible room; pooled policies preserve global category then arrival order
All schedules have 1080 paid staff minutes and 990 planned service minutes. Known outage removes overlapping availability, reported separately
Synthetic service capped at 30 minutes; universal clearance guard before every break/end prevents overtime, deliberately sacrifices capacity, and never inspects a patient's realised duration
Forecast models are evaluated even if worse than historical means; learned planning is not automatically preferred
Four planning samples can overfit the synthetic model; independent held-out replications expose losses without guaranteeing real benefit
Sensitivity schedules are frozen from base-demand planning, not retuned on test loads/outages
Paired intervals quantify simulation uncertainty conditional on assumptions; no real-world causal or clinical-effect claim
resource_planning.planning_objective: Minimise mean finite-horizon accumulated waiting across ALL arrivals; ties: unserved, then schedule name

replication_precision.rule: Report paired t-interval half-width; choose final study replication count prospectively for desired precision. No post-hoc favourable-run filtering or guaranteed power.

resource_planning.selection_boundary: Forecast fit/selection use development days only; four forecast-generated planning cohorts per candidate. Independent stream 40 is test-only; test outcomes never select schedules.

wait_prediction.interval_method: Absolute-residual split calibration; ceil((n+1)*0.8) order statistic; lower bound clipped at zero
limitations: Synthetic data; no claim about public patient ETA calibration
Within-day dependence and temporal shift invalidate an automatic exchangeability/coverage guarantee
Prediction error excludes unstarted/censored cases; all-arrival finite-horizon wait and counts are reported separately
Historical residual duration uses only pre-study completed synthetic durations, never realised future service end
Missing queue observations retain missing flags; baseline falls back to training-only median wait; no normal medical values imputed
wait_prediction.outcome_availability_purge: Exclude labels not known strictly before the next partition starts; no day/case crosses partitions
wait_prediction.selection_rule: Lowest selection-day MAE; freeze estimator, calibrate on later independent days, evaluate once on final days
wait_prediction.target: Consultation queue entry to service start; minutes; started cases only for prediction accuracy

warning: Synthetic research only — no clinical validation, autonomous decisions or live schedule changes
